boundary_adjoint.graph: H1(R_+) with <f,g>_H1=integral f conjugate(g)+integral f' conjugate(g')

conservative_incidence.cut_atom: c_a is the wall-extended translated theta cut column with regular derivative and a separate endpoint jump -Phi(0) at a
conservative_incidence.domain: history-plus-wall graph; raw c_a is not automatically in the old whole-line H1 domain

mismatch.support_and_shape: exp(-r) is the graph-Riesz representative of evaluation at the fixed radial boundary zero; c_(log p) is a prime-dependent translated theta cut profile with its wall atom at log p
mismatch.prime_dependence: pi_0^(star D) is independent of p, whereas B e_p varies with log p and carries p^(-1/2)
mismatch.conclusion: B is not pi_0^(star D) under the displayed native graph metric
mismatch.rejected_completion: one cannot turn A_aug=[[lambda_p,-pi_0],[0,S]] into C_FP merely by filling the lower-left entry with the native adjoint of pi_0 and identifying it with the existing B

distributional_warning: The transpose of pi_0 is delta_0 in the test dual, while its graph adjoint is exp(-r). Neither is the prime cut column B e_p; substituting delta_0 as an ambient L2 adjoint is invalid.

linking_sector.existing: K_link=-J_link/2 is a bounded skew Wronskian response block
linking_sector.limitation: because it is skew and preserves the old symmetric Green boundary form, it cannot by itself change the native symmetric adjoint pi_0^(star D) into B
linking_sector.role: it may supply the ordered linking component in an enlarged direct-sum response carrier, but a separate metric/source incidence comparison is still required

legal_repairs: use a source-pulled metric on the retained joint graph for which the adjoint of the complete boundary observation is B
enlarge the boundary observation from pi_0 to the full prime-labelled wall trace so its graph adjoint has one Riesz column per log p
retain B and pi_0 as distinct legs in a faithful joint graph and prove positivity by a block Schur/Douglas inequality rather than equality
next_test: Construct the full wall-evaluation operator Gamma=(gamma_(log p))_p on the countable broken-H1 graph and compute Gamma^(star G). Compare its p-th Riesz column with p^(-1/2)c_(log p) in the full history-plus-wall Gram, including cross-wall entries. This is the correct adjoint test; the single pi_0 test is definitively negative.
conclusion: The upper triangular augmented Euler square and the old conservative incidence do not form an adjoint pair in the native H1 metric. The failure is structural and prime-labelled, not a missing sign. The positive apex must retain the complete wall observation/source metric or use a joint-graph Douglas completion.
